rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides AI assistants with deep access to Windows internals through 18 tools spanning live process state monitoring, ETW kernel tracing, PE file import/export analysis, Windows Event Log retrieval, service enumeration, driver inspection, and minifilter analysis. Designed for security researchers and reverse engineers working on controlled systems. Published on PyPI as procmon-mcp and executable via uvx without installation; requires Windows administrator privileges.
